Waifu2x Desktop 1.0.1 improves first-launch model preparation.

- Downloads the complete model set as one `Waifu2x-models-v1.tar.xz` archive from this GitHub Release: **839,373,332 bytes (about 839 MB)**, about **23.4% smaller** than the unpacked model data.
- Verifies the archive's size and SHA-256, then verifies all 99 extracted model and helper files before use.
- Fixes the automatic handoff from model download and verification to the first-run tutorial, keeping the workspace blocked until models are ready. Existing tutorial completion preferences are preserved when upgrading.
- Completes model preparation and extraction messages across all seven supported languages.
- Marks the Waifu2x brand as verbatim text so Xcode no longer incorrectly extracts it as text awaiting translation.
- Keeps the app download separate from model weights. The model set expands to 1,095,327,613 bytes (about 1.1 GB).
- Includes checksums for the DMG, ZIP, and model archive together in `SHA256SUMS`.

**Apple Silicon only (arm64); macOS 26 or later.** Download `Waifu2x-1.0.1-macos-arm64.dmg`, open it, and drag **Waifu2x** to **Applications**, or extract the ZIP. The app downloads its model archive when needed; you do not need to install it manually. Image processing stays on your Mac.

The app uses an **ad-hoc signature, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization**. If macOS blocks the first launch and you trust the download, try opening the app, then choose **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. See [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/102445).

---

Waifu2x Desktop 1.0.1 改进首次启动时的模型准备流程。

- 从本次 GitHub Release 下载单个 `Waifu2x-models-v1.tar.xz` 归档，获取完整模型集：实际下载 **839,373,332 字节（约 839 MB）**，比解压后的模型数据**减少约 23.4%**。
- 核对归档大小和 SHA-256，并在使用前逐一验证解压后的 99 个模型及辅助文件。
- 修复模型下载、校验完成后自动进入首次使用教程的衔接，模型就绪前无法操作工作区；升级时保留已有教程完成记录。
- 完善全部七种界面语言的模型准备与解压提示。
- 将 Waifu2x 品牌文字标为原文，修复 Xcode 将其误提取为待翻译文本的提示。
- 应用安装包与模型权重分开提供。模型集解压后为 1,095,327,613 字节（约 1.1 GB）。
- `SHA256SUMS` 统一提供 DMG、ZIP 和模型归档的校验值。

**仅支持 Apple Silicon（arm64），要求 macOS 26 或更高版本。** 下载 `Waifu2x-1.0.1-macos-arm64.dmg`，打开后将 **Waifu2x** 拖入 **Applications（应用程序）**，也可解压 ZIP 安装。应用会在需要时自动下载模型归档，无需手动安装模型；图片处理始终在 Mac 本机完成。

应用使用 **临时签名（ad-hoc），未使用 Developer ID 签名，未经 Apple 公证**。若 macOS 阻止首次启动，且你信任此下载，可先尝试打开应用，再前往 **系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开**。详见 [Apple 操作说明](https://support.apple.com/zh-cn/102445)。
